description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called HomeContainerView, which manages the display of a home screen with navigation and a sheet presenting favorite recipes. It interacts with an application state store and handles UI elements like buttons and sheets.

classes.name: HomeContainerView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides a container for the home screen, managing navigation, favorites display, and environment objects.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view hierarchy including navigation bar, buttons, and a sheet for favorites.

methods.name: hasFavorites
methods.description: Computed property that checks if there are any favorite items.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Binding to the health state in the store, used for data flow into HomeView.
